theorems.name: Submission.p10_17ae7b7d_pp_fractional_iterates
theorems.statement: ∀ (p a j : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → 1 ≤ j → j < a → ∀ z : ZMod (p ^ a), p ^ j ∣ z.val → ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ z.val → let F : ZMod (p ^ a) → ZMod (p ^ a) := fun w => w * (1 + w)⁻¹; ∀ n : ℕ, IsUnit (1 + (n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z) ∧ (F^[n]) z = z * (1 + (n : ZMod (p ^ a)) * z)⁻¹ ∧ ((F^[n]) z = z ↔ p ^ (a - 2 * j) ∣ n) ∧ p ^ j ∣ ((F^[n]) z).val ∧ ¬ p ^ (j + 1) ∣ ((F^[n]) z).val
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted iterate-formula, unit-divisibility, and square-annihilation prerequisites to establish the period and preservation of exact valuation.
